title: Force Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the expression for the force acting on the electron as a function of distance r.

title: Motion Type
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately identify the type of motion executed by the electron.

title: Frequency Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the frequency of the electron's motion.

title: Use of Charge Density
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the concept of charge density in deriving the force expression.

title: Harmonic Motion Justification
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain why the force indicates simple harmonic motion.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student may make sign mistakes in the force expression or frequency derivation.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student might omit necessary factors in the force or frequency expressions.
